plan.title: SRC-AWD-010 — Award non-lowest bid and approve

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with the two bids on Master QCS.
Open the awarding page for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor A, the non-lowest bidder.
Assert that one line is selected, one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal value is 10 × 100 = 1,000.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Assert that the proposal page opened.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify that the submitted proposal is awaiting approval before the separate approver acts.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver, open this proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The catalog cannot perform the separate approver's login and approval.
Complete the post-approval purchase-order creation flow.
Assert that the resulting purchase order contains the single awarded line with quantity 10.
